query: db.students.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "enrollment_year": 1 }, output: { running_total: { $avg: "$gpa", window: { documents: ["unbounded", "current"] } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, name: 1, gpa: "$gpa", running_total: 1 } }])

db.students.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "enrollment_year": 1 }, output: { running_total: { $sum: "$gpa", window: { documents: [0, "current"] } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, name: 1, gpa: "$gpa", running_total: 1 } }])
